mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past 6 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the housing market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 55% of instances following a FEDFUNDS decrease.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals strong job growth, which is a positive indicator for economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the job growth signal.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% each over the past 3 months signals a broad-based economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and INDPRO increase > 1% each in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the broad-based expansion signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the contraction signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over the past 6 months signals strong economic growth, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances despite the strong growth signal.
